description: Industry-grade stable API for flights AND hotels with multi-product cart booking — search flights and hotels via Jinko's contracted supplier network (Sabre, Travelfusion, Nuitee), build one trip containing both, and check out via a Jinko-hosted Stripe page from the terminal.
auth_description: Get an API key at https://app.gojinko.com/devplatform, then export JINKO_API_KEY or pass via the CLI's auth flag. The same credential works with @gojinko/cli (Node) and Jinko's MCP server.

novel_features.name: Multi-product trip in one cart
novel_features.description: Jinko is the only travel CLI in this library that books flights AND hotels together in one trip. A single trip_id accepts both flight and hotel offer tokens; checkout returns one Stripe payment URL for the whole cart.

novel_features.name: Agent-friendly token flow
novel_features.command: flights create-search, shop create-sync, shop create-fulfillment
novel_features.description: Named tokens compose left-to-right: offer_token (cached search) → trip_item_token (live, bookable) → trip_id (cart) → checkout_url (Stripe). Quote is automatic; no implicit hidden state.

novel_features.name: Contracted-supplier inventory
novel_features.description: Live rates from Jinko's contracted supplier network (Sabre, Travelfusion, Nuitee). Stable API, industry SLA — not reverse-engineered or cookie-scraped. The same backend powers production bookings on app.gojinko.com.

novel_features.name: End-to-end lifecycle polling
novel_features.description: One endpoint returns cart, quote, payment, fulfillment, and PNRs. Designed for long-running async bookings (TravelFusion confirmations can take up to 72h) — agents poll this to know when to send confirmation emails.
